status: Checked update-program and captured-row-effects milestone; mixed serial-history extension remains open
evidence_class: Handwritten source-mapped Lean model and independently specified effects; not Rust/SQL extraction or refinement
implementation_changes: None. Current native fix/source applicability checked against native-stale-update.json; no native tests rerun.

claims.committing_program_complete: Every reached update commit request in any finite fixed mixed execution stages exactly deployment metadata then the keyed matched-row patch; both ordering and updated outcome are derived from real steps, not required by primitive commit.
claims.committing_exact_fields: Applying that reached staged program gives the independent expectedMatched transformation of its actual captured row. Current-row stability until commit is not yet proved.
claims.noop_program_discarded: A reached no-op rollback/aborted state retains exactly the metadata-only private staged program and no matched row; this is a staging theorem, not general event exclusion.
claims.rollback_noop_exact: An actual no-op rollback transition preserves committed database, update event list and original registration commit list; it does not freeze other writers until acknowledgement.
claims.field_effects: Patch changes only client metadata, software statement and update time. Current matched-row identity/login/digest/issue-time/stable remainder, other replicas, roles, frame and deployment storage binding are preserved. Row-carried binding is ghost admission context, not a native column.

validation.warnings: Unused section-variable warnings remain; no proof errors or unreviewed axioms in successful package.

development_feedback: Review corrected illegal Prop-to-Type classification into a relation over real registration steps, keyed row writes by request client, and partitioned failed update attempts by their ghost method identity.

Model1 had a dotted-identifier elaboration failure; Effects1 had an unintroduced other-key contradiction; Proof2/3 needed phase-specialization and explicit abort-branch reasoning. These were proof-script/typechecking failures, not semantic negative controls.

Three launch preflights stopped before compiling: a malformed expected hash, nested shell/awk quoting, and a truncated hash. Final manifests were generated from actual file bytes and verified unchanged before/after one successful package build.
assumptions_and_boundaries: One retained deployment, external namespace admission, admitted changed-metadata store calls; native metadata statement constraints are an explicit relation independent of lock/post-state correctness.
Real fixed registration transition relation retained. Static method identities, captured rows and event lists are ghost proof data; no runtime bookkeeping or auth rule is added.
PostgreSQL statement snapshots, transactional staging/commit/rollback and row-lock semantics are modeled assumptions, not proofs of PostgreSQL.
Authentication/crypto/serialization, SQL/Core refinement, service equal-metadata short circuit, postcommit audit/reload/reply and deployed behavior remain outside.
Current-row stability, arbitrary mixed independent serial histories, general abort-event exclusion, constructive valid update/no-op histories and the old-update counterexample remain next.
Removal/housekeeping, broader authority/identity-reuse composition, cross-database preparation and liveness/recovery are not claimed.
